item.text: The dataset is a 69×69×115 image volume. I’ve confirmed the TTK persistence-diagram and persistence-simplification filters are available; next I’m inspecting the simplified output schema so the render can select only dimensions 0 and 2 accurately.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "/opt/conda/bin/pvpython - <<'PY'
from paraview.simple import *
r=XMLImageDataReader(FileName=['/workspace/QMCPACK.vti'])
p=TTKPersistenceDiagram(Input=r); p.ScalarField=['POINTS','Scalars_']; p.Dimensions='All Dimensions'
s=TTKTopologicalSimplificationByPersistence(Input=p); s.PersistenceThreshold=0.04; s.ThresholdIsAbsolute=1
UpdatePipeline(proxy=s)
for label,o in [('orig',p),('simpl',s)]:
 d=o.GetDataInformation(); print(label,d.GetDataSetTypeAsString(),d.GetNumberOfPoints(),d.GetNumberOfCells())
 print('point',[(d.GetPointDataInformation().GetArrayInformation(i).GetName(),d.GetPointDataInformation().GetArrayInformation(i).GetNumberOfComponents()) for i in range(d.GetPointDataInformation().GetNumberOfArrays())])
 print('cell',[(d.GetCellDataInformation().GetArrayInformation(i).GetName(),d.GetCellDataInformation().GetArrayInformation(i).GetNumberOfComponents()) for i in range(d.GetCellDataInformation().GetNumberOfArrays())])
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "/opt/conda/bin/pvpython - <<'PY' 2>/dev/null
from paraview.simple import *
from paraview import servermanager
r=XMLImageDataReader(FileName=['/workspace/QMCPACK.vti'])
p=TTKPersistenceDiagram(Input=r); p.ScalarField=['POINTS','Scalars_'];p.Dimensions='All Dimensions'
UpdatePipeline(proxy=p)
d=servermanager.Fetch(p)
cd=d.GetCellData(); pts=d.GetPoints();
for i in range(d.GetNumberOfCells()):
 c=d.GetCell(i); ids=c.GetPointIds(); b=cd.GetArray('Birth').GetValue(i); pers=cd.GetArray('Persistence').GetValue(i); typ=cd.GetArray('PairType').GetValue(i); finite=cd.GetArray('IsFinite').GetValue(i)
 if typ in (0,2) and pers>=.04: print(i,int(typ),finite,b,b+pers,pers,tuple(round(x,5) for x in pts.GetPoint(ids.GetId(0))),tuple(round(x,5) for x in pts.GetPoint(ids.GetId(1))))
PY"
